notes.title: Update Notes for October 19
notes.content:
A small patch to fix an issue with split screen crashing when anyone finished the race.

I have decided to include some other quality of life changes that were live in our develop branch.

A fix has been added to stop players getting 'stuck' if they move from one room to a room that was not a neighbouring room.  This could happen if you moved diagonally across the corner of a room into another.  The room check will now recursively move outwards until it can locate which room it is in.

This patch also adds changes to select the OK buttons for the prompt to play online and the prompt to join the IMR.  This will allow users to use the spacebar to navigate into the IMR instead of having to use their mouse to click the OK button.

Finally, if you are launching a race from the IMR with no other players, the wait time to game start will be the same as offline practice, 6 seconds.  There is no point waiting 20 seconds if you are playing on your own.

notes.title: Update Notes for Feb 26
notes.content:
In this patch we have added split times in the players list if you press F5.  These are useful for sessions with friends where you are trying to set a best lap.  You will be able to see if a player is ahead or behind their best lap as they pass through checkpoints.

Another addition sees positions change on the same players list during laps.  Usually it would only update at the end of each lap, but now if a player passes another before reaching the next checkpoint, the positions on the leaderboard will update to reflect this.

Finally, the Hovercraft should shake less on the screen after a change was made to only refresh when the game performs a simulation, which will make the game look better.

The reason for the increase in version from 1.23.5 to 1.23.6 is to accommodate the change in data sent over the network, so that we could avoid compatibility issues while testing.

Any issues, let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/vXmy2m3GWm]Discord[/url].
